cc:Work.dc:title: Simplicity
cc:Work.dc:description: Physical, historical nonblank and later nonblank/noncomment source lines across 28 snapshots, on a zero-based axis. Dedicated consolidation removes 1842 physical lines from Phase5 to Phase7. Later coverage and performance work increases source size to 28490 physical lines. Nonblank and code-line series are distinct and missing counts are left unplotted. Source size is a proxy, not a complete measure of simplicity.
